title: Neuroendocrine Mechanisms of Growth and Body Composition in Preterm and Term Infants
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the feasibility of measuring body composition by air displacement plethysmography (ADP) in rapidly growing, medically stable late gestation \[32-35 weeks post-menstrual age (PMA)\] premature infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants born between 32 4/7 and 35 3/7 weeks gestation or 37 4/7 and 42 3/7 weeks gestation, by physical exam at birth
* Birth weight between the 5th and 95th percentile corrected for gestational age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chromosomal abnormalities
* Major congenital anomalies
* Major surgery
* Severe CNS injury
* Inborn errors of metabolism
* Assisted ventilation
* Inability to start enteral feeds by 96 hours of age
study_population: Premature and full term infants admitted to the University of Utah Newborn Intensive Care Unit, Intermediate Nursery or Well Baby Nursery
